title: MAIN EVENT — АвгустVPN против Free VPN
look: Real live pay-per-view MMA broadcast footage, not a commercial: bright even overhead TV lighting, a white octagon canvas, black padded posts, black chain-link cage fence, a dark packed arena beyond with phone lights in the crowd. Broadcast-camera image with natural motion blur and slight lens breathing.

set_refs.what: the white octagon canvas with the black shield emblem and the words SECURITY ARENA in its center

august.name: AUGUST

refs.what: yellow logo printed on the chest of his black fight jersey

august.description: a lean athletic blond fighter with a very short buzzcut and pale blue eyes, wearing a black fitted short-sleeve fight jersey, black fight shorts and plain black fingerless MMA gloves; calm, focused, slightly ironic

adgar.name: ADGAR

refs.what: big green shield patch sewn on the center of his chest

adgar.description: a giant super-heavyweight brute with a thick dark beard, twice as broad as an ordinary fighter, wearing a fitted fight jersey and fight shorts covered in dozens of cheap mismatched colorful sponsor patches, plain black fingerless MMA gloves; loud, angry, all show

announcer.name: THE ANNOUNCER
announcer.description: a charismatic ring announcer with slicked back silver hair in a black tuxedo with a black bow tie, holding a silver handheld microphone

referee.name: THE REFEREE
referee.description: a bald referee in a plain black short-sleeve shirt and black trousers, wearing thin black latex gloves

caster_a.name: THE PLAY-BY-PLAY COMMENTATOR
caster_a.description: a middle-aged commentator in a dark suit with a broadcast headset microphone

caster_b.name: THE COLOR COMMENTATOR
caster_b.description: a retired fighter turned commentator with a shaved head and a tight black polo shirt, wearing a broadcast headset microphone

shots.framing: medium close-up of the announcer in the center of the octagon, the cage and the dark crowd behind him
shots.purpose: Hook: the broadcast opens like a real title fight; the line carries the first three seconds.

beats.text: The Steadicam operator arcs slowly to the left around him, keeping his face framed, the cage lights flaring behind his head.
He lifts the microphone to his lips and fills his chest.
He throws his free arm up toward the arena lights.

dialogue.line: Ladies and gentlemen... this is the main event!
dialogue.delivery: in a booming, perfectly clear arena voice, stretching the last words

shots.soundscape: His voice through the arena PA with light natural reverb; the crowd erupts into a roar on the last word.

shots.framing: medium shot of Adgar in his corner against the padded post
shots.purpose: Introduce the free VPN: huge, loud, covered in cheap sponsor patches.

beats.text: {adgar} slams his gloves together and bellows at the crowd.
He lunges toward the lens; the operator steps back and tilts up to keep his head in frame, overshooting slightly and correcting.
He flexes, showing off the patches on his chest.

shots.soundscape: The arena PA booms: 'In the red corner... FREE VPN!' Mixed boos and cheers, his roar close to the camera microphone.

shots.framing: medium close-up of August in the opposite corner
shots.purpose: Introduce August: no show, total calm; the contrast is the joke.

beats.text: {august} rolls his neck and his shoulders, completely relaxed.
The operator drifts closer and reframes onto his face, with a brief focus hunt.
He gives the lens a small, confident nod and a barely visible smile.

shots.soundscape: The arena PA: 'And in the blue corner... AUGUST VPN!' A clean, warm roar of the crowd.

shots.framing: medium-wide profile three-shot of the face-off in the center of the octagon
shots.purpose: Scale: the free VPN is a giant; the referee gives instructions.

beats.text: {august} and {adgar} stand nose to nose; {august} tilts his chin up to hold eye contact while {adgar} glares down at him; {referee} stands between them, one hand raised.
The cage-side operator follows {adgar} leaning in and makes a small zoom adjustment to hold both heads in frame.
{august} offers his glove for a touch; {adgar} slaps it away with a sneer.

dialogue.line: Protect yourselves at all times. Touch gloves.
dialogue.delivery: flatly, in a firm low voice

shots.soundscape: A tense crowd murmur, the referee's voice close and dry, the slap of gloves.

shots.framing: over-the-shoulder shot from behind Adgar's huge shoulder onto August looking up

beats.text: The operator holds on the blurred mass of {adgar}'s shoulder in the right foreground, then racks focus to {august}'s eyes.
{august} looks up at {adgar}, unbothered, and raises one eyebrow.

shots.soundscape: Crowd murmur, the heavy breathing of {adgar} close to the microphone.

shots.framing: low-angle close-up of Adgar looking down, August's blond head soft in the left foreground
shots.purpose: The free VPN's only argument: it is free.

beats.text: The operator tilts up from {august}'s shoulder to {adgar}'s face, re-centering as he leans down.
{adgar} jabs a thumb at the patches on his own chest, grinning.

dialogue.delivery: loudly, with a heavy accent and a proud grin

shots.soundscape: A ripple of laughter in the crowd.

shots.framing: wide shot of the octagon as the fight starts
shots.purpose: FASTER: the free VPN lags; a stutter and a buffering spinner are added in the edit on the frozen moment.

beats.text: {adgar} charges across the canvas toward {august}.
The operator pans with {adgar}, the frame lagging behind his charge and catching up.
Mid-stride {adgar} suddenly freezes completely still, like a paused video, one foot in the air, for a full second, then jerks forward again in a choppy, stuttering motion.
{august} calmly sidesteps; {adgar} stutters straight past him into the cage fence and bounces softly off the padding.

shots.soundscape: The bell rings once. The crowd gasps when he freezes, then bursts out laughing.

shots.framing: medium two-shot of the commentators at their desk
shots.purpose: The broadcast names the joke so the viewer does not have to.

beats.text: The locked-off camera holds on both of them as they lean toward the monitors in disbelief.
{caster_b} takes off his headset and stares at it.

dialogue.line: That's a free connection for you.

shots.soundscape: Booth room tone, muffled crowd through the glass.

shots.framing: medium-wide shot of both fighters in the center of the octagon
shots.purpose: MORE RELIABLE: the free VPN disconnects mid-swing; a CONNECTION LOST glitch is added in the edit.

beats.text: {adgar} winds up a huge slow overhand swing, far away from {august}, who simply waits.
Halfway through the swing {adgar} goes completely limp, as if his power cable was pulled, and topples forward stiff as a plank, landing flat on the soft canvas without touching anyone.
The operator tilts down following the fall, with a quick overshoot and correction.
{august} looks down at him and shrugs.

shots.soundscape: A falling electronic power-down tone as he goes limp, a soft thud on the canvas, a stunned silence, then a huge crowd roar.

shots.framing: top-down wide shot of the octagon canvas
shots.purpose: SAFER: while he lies there, the edit covers him in pop-up ads; the PA tries to sell him.

beats.text: {adgar} lies spread-eagled on his back in the middle of the SECURITY ARENA logo, blinking slowly at the ceiling; {august} stands calmly nearby; {referee} waves both arms over his head to end the fight.
The cable camera descends toward the canvas and settles above {adgar}.

shots.soundscape: The arena PA, cheerful: 'Want to sponsor this fighter? Contact our sales department!' The crowd laughs.

shots.framing: medium shot of the referee raising August's hand
shots.purpose: Payoff: the winner. Hands over to the packshot.

beats.text: {referee} raises {august}'s arm high; gold confetti falls through the cage lights.
The Steadicam operator arcs slowly around them toward {august}'s face, the horizon drifting slightly and being corrected.
{august} looks into the lens with a calm, satisfied smile.

shots.soundscape: The crowd roaring and chanting, confetti cannons popping.
shots.music: A short triumphant brass-and-drums sting starting at 00:02.000.
